documentsRequired: As required on the official portal
title: Bihar Dakhil Kharij, Registration Online 2026
organization: Department of Revenue & Land Reforms, Government of Bihar
postName: Land Mutation (Dakhil Kharij) Online Application – Bihar
vacancyDetails: Online mutation / dakhil-kharij and related land registration services in Bihar
howToApply:
1. Visit Bihar land records / Bhumi / Registration related official portal (e.g. biharbhumi.bihar.gov.in / serviceonline)
2. Select Dakhil-Kharij / Mutation service
3. Fill land details, seller-buyer information
4. Upload sale deed and ID proofs
5. Pay fee and track application status
shortDescription: Bihar Dakhil Kharij (land mutation) and registration online 2026 – apply via official Bihar land/revenue portals.
content:
Dakhil Kharij is the process of mutating land records after sale, inheritance or gift in Bihar.

Citizens can apply online through state land records / ServicePlus portals, upload registered deed documents and track mutation status. Always use government websites and verify khata/khesra details carefully before submission.
